feat(compliance): structured_logger.py — Factor XI / G-20

- New: compliance/utils/structured_logger.py
  One JSON line per event → stdout → ClickHouse pipeline
  Correlation IDs: tx_id + case_id + scenario_id (replay capability G-01 partial)
  Methods: event(), decision(), warning_event(), error_event(), critical_event()
  None-values stripped — clean ClickHouse schema

- sanctions_check.py: structured logging via _log
  JURISDICTION_A_BLOCK (CRITICAL), SANCTIONS_SCREEN_HIT/CLEAR, YENTE_UNAVAILABLE, WATCHMAN_UNAVAILABLE

- banxe_aml_orchestrator.py: _log.decision() after every BanxeAMLResult
  Logs: decision, composite_score, tx_id, case_id, channel, policy_version

- All 57 tests pass

Closes: GAP-REGISTER G-20 (Factor XI compliance logging)
Invariant: I-24 (audit events logged), supports G-01 (replay via correlation IDs)
